in_hindi.name: जितेन
in_hindi.long_meaning: विजित (vijit) + न (an) = विजिती (vijiti) + न (an) = जितेन (jiten) = conqueror, overcomer, victorious one

in_marathi.name: Jiten
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jiten हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jiten is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Conquerer, Victor'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit', meaning 'to conquer, to overcome'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to grow up and achieve great things, and to overcome any obstacles that may come his way.
